scenes.title: Seven Maids in Three Days
scenes.summary: Eleonora fires maids over their expressions and smashes hotel TVs showing Nagiyev, prompting Barinov to tell Mikhail to call her psychiatrist.

scenes.title: Collecting Money and Jealousy
scenes.summary: Senya collects three thousand rubles from the chefs for his birthday while Katya coldly rejects Denis over his kiss with Sveta.

scenes.title: Lyova's Morning and Doctor's Advice
scenes.summary: Lyova wakes up in Ainura's crowded apartment while Eleonora's psychiatrist recommends a quiet countryside sanatorium with a pool.

scenes.title: A Blunt Question
scenes.summary: Eleonora fires her psychiatrist, Sveta lies to Katya that she and Denis are dating, and Senya demands birthday cash from the waitresses.

scenes.title: Discount on a Fishfinder
scenes.summary: Sveta claims to Denis that she told Katya they are just friends, while Fedya reveals Senya is collecting birthday money early to buy a fishfinder on sale.

scenes.title: Onion Soup with a Surprise
scenes.summary: Barinov brings Eleonora wine and French onion soup laced with sleeping pills so the orderlies can take her to the sanatorium.

scenes.title: Escape to the Wedding
scenes.summary: Eleonora escapes the clinic and crashes the wedding banquet in the dining hall, scolding Barinov and warning the bride about men.

scenes.title: Quarrel at the Entrance and a Place to Sleep
scenes.summary: Katya rejects Denis's flowers and leaves with Nikita out of jealousy over Sveta, while Lyova is given a top bunk at Ainura's crowded flat.

scenes.title: Shower Line and Diagnosis
scenes.summary: Lyova wakes up third in line for the shower at Ainura's flat, and the psychiatrist warns that Eleonora must avoid all reminders of Nagiyev.

scenes.title: A Jealousy Plan and a Call to Nagiyev
scenes.summary: Nikita advises Denis to bring another girl to Senya's party to make Katya jealous, while Mikhail persuades Barinov to summon Nagiyev.

scenes.title: Congratulations and Couples for the Evening
scenes.summary: Lyova asks Ainura for another night's lodging, the staff congratulates Senya, and Denis and Katya announce rival dates for the party.

scenes.title: Nagiyev's Arrival
scenes.summary: Barinov reminds Nagiyev why reconciling with Eleonora guarantees his future comfort and brings him to Eleonora's table in the dining room.

scenes.title: The Actor's Repentance
scenes.summary: Nagiyev dramatically begs Eleonora for forgiveness at her table, and Eleonora calmly asks him to declare his love without theatrics.

scenes.title: Public Divorce
scenes.summary: Eleonora makes Nagiyev shout that he loves her in front of the entire restaurant before publicly dumping him and ordering champagne for everyone.

scenes.title: Toasts for the Birthday Boy
scenes.summary: Denis with Sveta and Katya with Nikita present their birthday gifts to Senya, and Denis asks Sveta to hug him to make Katya jealous.

scenes.title: The Third Wheel
scenes.summary: Sveta provokes Katya at the bar, prompting Denis to kiss Sveta and Katya to impulsively kiss Senya in return.

scenes.title: Midnight Document Check
scenes.summary: Migration police raid Ainura's crowded apartment at night and are baffled to find Muscovite Lyova living there for his girlfriend Gulya.

scenes.title: Lyova's Noble Deed
scenes.summary: Lyova gives the officer all his apartment savings to save not only Gulya and Ainura, but all the migrant workers in the apartment.

scenes.title: Eleonora's Proposal
scenes.summary: Eleonora proposes marriage to Barinov, believing his actions proved he still loves her, and vows revenge when he rejects her for Elena.

scenes.title: Secret Pact and First Place
scenes.summary: Marina takes Senya home after his party, Nikita and Sveta celebrate their plot to separate Katya and Denis, and Lyova gets first place in the shower line.
